exposure: UGT1A1 genetic variant rs4148323 (A allele vs G allele)
UGT1A1 genetic variant rs3064744 ((TA)7 allele vs (TA)6 allele)
cohort: The study included 484 Japanese infants whose clinical data and genotype data for two UGT1A1 genetic variants were retrospectively analyzed.
finding: The A allele in rs4148323 was significantly associated with an increased risk of hyper-free bilirubinemia, while the (TA)7 allele in rs3064744 was significantly associated with a decreased risk.
